coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a quick shower
Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle
Getting dressed, packing work bag and checking the day's patient schedule on phone
Commuting to the hospital by public transport (bus/train)
Working as a hospital physiotherapist, treating and rehabilitating patients
Taking a lunch break at the hospital cafeteria
Continuing physiotherapy sessions, assessments and patient record documentation
Commuting home from the hospital by public transport (bus/train)
Cooking and eating dinner, washing up dishes in the dishwasher
Loading the washing machine and doing laundry
Moving laundry to the clothes dryer and tidying up the room
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
Using the computer to review rehabilitation literature and plan tomorrow's therapy exercises
Taking an evening shower and brushing teeth
Winding down with the phone, setting tomorrow's alarm and going to sleep
